column3: NASB recasts the verse (“Treat others the same way you want them to treat you”).
NASB follows the critical text; it adds “back.”
NASB follows the critical text (“Most High”) and adds “men.”
NASB follows the critical text without “therefore.”
NASB follows the critical text; “forgive” is rendered “pardon.”
NASB follows the critical text and adds “For”; “re-measured” is rendered “measured … in return.”
NASB follows the critical text; “fall in” is rendered “fall into.”
NASB follows the critical text; “disciple” is rendered “pupil.”
NASB follows the critical text without “or”; “splinter” and “beam” are “speck” and “log.”
NASB follows the critical text; “again” is rendered “on the other hand.”
NASB adds “men”; “bramble bush” is rendered “briar bush.”
NASB follows the critical text; “out of the overflow of the heart” is rendered “from that which fills his heart.”
NASB follows the critical text (“because it had been well built”); “dug and deepened” is rendered “dug deep.”
NASB follows the critical text (“collapsed”); “not having done” is rendered “has not acted accordingly.”
